description: P0 — Scaffold Next.js, Turso/Drizzle, Auth.js, shell, schema, seed

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js tooling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Next.js app scaffolded at repo root with TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, Playwright scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: create-next-app at repo root preserving docs/, scripts/, .cursor/
package.json scripts: dev, build, lint, typecheck, test, test:e2e, db:generate, db:migrate, db:seed
.env.example with TURSO_DATABASE_URL, TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN, AUTH_SECRET, CRON_SECRET, DEMO_PROFILE_SWITCHER

userStories.title: Margin and pipeline pure functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tested pure functions for gross margin and weighted pipeline value.
acceptanceCriteria: grossMargin returns null when revenue is 0

userStories.title: pt-BR formatters
userStories.description: As a user, I want currency, dates and percents in pt-BR/BRL.

userStories.title: Organizations and profiles schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Drizzle + Turso client and organizations/profiles tables.
acceptanceCriteria: organizations and profiles with role admin|manager|seller

userStories.title: Auth.js login and RBAC helpers
userStories.description: As a demo user, I can log in with email/password and routes are protected.

userStories.title: Dashboard shell and route stubs
userStories.description: As a user, I see industrial shell, synthetic badge, and navigable stubs for all main routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Stub pages for all main routes without 404
Verify in browser if tools available

userStories.title: Full business schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all domain tables from the design spec.
acceptanceCriteria: All entities from design §6 in Drizzle schema

userStories.title: Minimal demo seed
userStories.description: As a demo user, I can log in with three seeded accounts and see sample data.
acceptanceCriteria: 3 demo users with documented passwords in README
npm run db:seed works with Turso or file libsql
userStories.notes: Needs TURSO_* or file: URL in .env

userStories.title: Full deterministic seed batched
userStories.description: As a developer, I can load full synthetic volumes via batched seed.
acceptanceCriteria: Volumes match design §9 (or batched path documented)
